description: This file contains unit tests for serialization behavior involving generic base classes in the Orleans framework. It defines an abstract generic base class, a derived class, and a test class that verifies whether the serializer correctly handles serialization capabilities based on explicit attribute marking.

classes.name: Base<T>
classes.description: An abstract generic base class marked with [GenerateSerializer], used to test serialization behavior with generic base classes.

classes.name: Derived
classes.description: A concrete class inheriting from Base<int>, used in serialization tests.

classes.name: GenericBaseClassTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies whether the serializer correctly identifies serializable types based on explicit attribute marking, especially for derived classes from generic base classes.

methods.name: GenericBaseClassTest()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up dependency injection and initializes the serializer for testing.

methods.name: DerivedNoGeneric
methods.description: Test method that asserts the serializer cannot serialize the Derived class, verifying correct handling of serialization attributes.
